blocking.where: TRD.md — CON-ADD-SET-INTERFACE — Field rules (CON-EDIT-SET-INTERFACE repeats it)
blocking.why: PRD.md FEAT-ADD-SET acceptance requires 'Saving with Weight (kg) 82.55 stores nothing', and PRD Operational Constraints says 'at most one decimal place'. This regex accepts 82.55 and its rejection message names 2 places. The escape clause ('unless the behavior states another count') leaves the coder choosing between the literal regex and the PRD.
blocking.fix: Change the regex to ^[0-9]+([.][0-9]?)?$ and the message to 'Weight (kg) must have at most 1 decimal place' in both interface contracts.

blocking.quote: A production entry point that uses a test double, or a platform owner the running app never calls, blocks completion.
blocking.why: TASKS.md TASK-08 exempts Packaging.assertProductionWiring and LifecycleCoordinator.stop() from this rule, and no production code calls either. TRD has higher authority than TASKS, so the coder cannot tell whether completion is blocked.
blocking.fix: Amend the TRD CON-RUNTIME-WIRING failure line to name Packaging.assertProductionWiring and LifecycleCoordinator.stop() as exempt, matching TASKS.md TASK-08.

blocking.quote: the inline form shell, which hosts whichever form (add or edit) is open, one at a time, so opening one closes the other
blocking.why: The same prompt says open-form state lives in the later task's own feature file and never in shared view state. TASK-04 must build a shell that enforces one-open-form, but it cannot reference that state, and no slot API between the shell and the form tasks is specified.
blocking.fix: Specify in TASK-04 that the shell takes a nullable open-form composable slot that App.kt fills from an open-state function each form task exports, and name those functions in TASK-05 and TASK-07.

polish.quote: build the main screen content area and the shared view state
polish.why: Files to create lists only SetListFeature.kt and Files to modify lists only App.kt, so the coder cannot tell which file holds the shared view state that later tasks extend.
polish.fix: Name the file that holds the shared view state (SetListFeature.kt) in the TASK-04 file list.

polish.quote: Room writes the schema JSON app/schemas/(the AppDatabase class name)/1.json when the project builds
polish.why: Room names the schema directory by the database's canonical class name (com.lift.log.platform.datastore.AppDatabase), so the literal path is ambiguous and the committed schema file may land elsewhere.

polish.quote: An acceptance criterion listed here that a feature task already built (a rejected Save, a row action) is asserted by the packaging focused test as well
polish.why: TASK-08 lists no feature acceptance criteria, so 'listed here' refers to nothing. The coder cannot tell which Compose screen tests PackagingTest must contain.
polish.fix: Name the acceptance IDs (for example ACC-ADD-SET-03 and ACC-DELETE-SET-02) that PackagingTest must drive through App(container).

polish.why: ARD.md lists about 20 files for OWN-FOUNDATION, while TRD narrows the implementation to one file. The owner's file set differs between documents.
polish.fix: Replace the TRD OWN-FOUNDATION implementation entry with the full ARD file list.

polish.why: PRD.md calls it the 'Add set button' and no label is given, so the coder must guess the visible text.
polish.fix: Label the button 'Add set' with testTag add-entry to match PRD.md.

polish.quote: a sort breaks ties by id in the sort's own direction
polish.why: PRD requires same-date sets ordered by creation time, and Created at is stored, yet TRD tie-breaks by id. The two give the same result, but the coder may sort by Created at with no stated tie-break.
polish.fix: State that the list sorts by Date then Created at descending, with id as the final tie-break.

review.verdict: Not buildable without guesswork. Three blocking defects: the weight decimal rule contradicts PRD acceptance, the completion-gate exemption contradicts TRD, and open-form state ownership is undefined. Fix these before a coding agent starts. blueprint.json was not provided and was not audited.
